tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a low chaise, both legs lifted high and crossed at the ankles while holding a small sketchbook aloft, feet turned so the soles face the viewer.
tasks.camera: low front view looking up at the raised feet and sketchbook
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles and all four toes per foot fully unobstructed, facing camera
tasks.intent_zh: 躺椅抬腿画画展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Seated on a wooden stool, the blue tiger leans back and balances a spinning plate on one raised foot, the other foot flat with sole angled toward the lens, grinning.
tasks.camera: eye-level three-quarter shot capturing both feet and the plate
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised sole and flat sole both fully visible with all toes
tasks.intent_zh: 坐凳用脚转盘子展示双足

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on the floor doing a seated toe-touch stretch, both legs extended forward, heels planted and soles presented to the camera while both hands reach for the toes.
tasks.camera: front low angle framing the extended leg soles and reaching hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Soles face forward unobstructed; both five-fingered hands clearly seen
tasks.intent_zh: 坐姿体前屈展示手掌与脚掌

tasks.instruction: Lying on his back on a rug, the blue tiger pedals an imaginary bicycle in the air, both soles rotating toward the viewer, one hand behind his head and the other pointing at the ceiling.
tasks.camera: overhead angled view down onto the upturned soles
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles and all toes visible during pedal motion, soles toward camera
tasks.intent_zh: 仰卧空中蹬车展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Perched sideways on a tall bar stool, the blue tiger kicks both legs forward and holds a mug of cocoa between his soles, feet pressed together with pads facing the lens.
tasks.camera: front view at foot level centered on the two soles and mug
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles pressed together, fully visible, cup not obscuring toes
tasks.intent_zh: 用双足夹杯展示脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits atop a rolling library ladder, legs dangling and swinging while he reads a folded newspaper, both soles turned outward toward the camera mid-swing.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter view from below the ladder looking up at soles
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both swinging soles fully visible with four toes each
tasks.intent_zh: 梯上读书晃腿展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Reclining in a hammock that sags low, the blue tiger plants both feet against a tree trunk, soles facing the viewer, while folding a paper airplane with both hands.
tasks.camera: side-front view capturing the soles braced on the trunk
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles pressed against trunk, pads and toes clearly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 吊床蹬树折纸展示手与脚掌

tasks.instruction: Seated in a large armchair, the blue tiger lifts both legs straight up in a V, soles facing camera, and juggles three small oranges with his hands above his feet.
tasks.camera: front wide shot showing raised soles and juggling hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: All four toes per raised sole visible; five fingers per hand visible
tasks.intent_zh: 椅上举腿抛橙展示手掌与脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged but leans far back on his hands, lifting both feet off the floor and presenting the soles to the camera while balancing a book on his knees.
tasks.camera: front low angle focused on the elevated soles and supporting hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles raised and facing camera; supporting hands flat with fingers visible
tasks.intent_zh: 后仰撑手举脚展示手掌脚掌

tasks.instruction: Kneeling on a padded bench, the blue tiger shifts weight to sit back on his heels, then flips both feet up behind him so the soles face the camera above his back.
tasks.camera: rear overhead view capturing upturned soles above the back
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles raised and fully visible above the back, toes spread
tasks.intent_zh: 跪姿后抬足展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a low wall, the blue tiger extends both legs toward the viewer and uses his toes to grip a paintbrush, painting on a canvas propped at his feet.
tasks.camera: front close view on the feet and canvas, hand resting on knee
tasks.visibility_requirement: Soles and toes gripping brush clearly visible facing camera
tasks.intent_zh: 用脚趾握笔作画展示脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on his side on a picnic blanket, propped on one elbow, with both legs lifted and soles facing the viewer as he examines a map.
tasks.camera: eye-level side view angled to show both upturned soles
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles visible side by side, all toes and pads shown
tasks.intent_zh: 侧卧举足看地图展示手掌脚掌

tasks.instruction: Seated on a swing, the blue tiger leans back and pushes both feet forward, soles toward the camera, holding the ropes with both hands while a scarf flutters.
tasks.camera: front dynamic shot of soles and gripping hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles thrust toward camera with toes visible; five fingers gripping rope
tasks.intent_zh: 荡秋千伸脚展示手掌与脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits in a beanbag chair, knees bent up, and balances a stack of books on both soles, holding another book open in his hands.
tasks.camera: front view at seat height on soles and book stack
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles supporting books, pads and toes visible around edges
tasks.intent_zh: 豆袋椅脚掌顶书展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a chaise with a laptop, the blue tiger crosses his legs, then uncrosses and stretches both feet toward the camera, soles splayed wide as he types.
tasks.camera: low front angle focused on splayed soles and laptop
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles splayed toward camera with four toes each visible
tasks.intent_zh: 躺椅打字伸脚展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a carpet, the blue tiger rolls a small ball between his soles, feet facing the viewer, while stacking wooden blocks with both hands.
tasks.camera: front floor-level shot of soles and ball and hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles framing the ball, toes and pads visible; five fingers stacking blocks
tasks.intent_zh: 脚掌滚球堆木块展示手掌脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits in a canoe, feet propped on the opposite seat with soles facing the camera, paddling with both hands over one side.
tasks.camera: front view inside the canoe framing soles and paddle hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles propped and fully visible with all toes
tasks.intent_zh: 独木舟划桨展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Perched on a kitchen counter, the blue tiger lifts both feet and holds a whisk between his toes, mixing a bowl balanced on his knees.
tasks.camera: close front view of whisking toes and bowl
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles raised, toes gripping whisk, pads visible
tasks.intent_zh: 脚趾打蛋展示双足底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a staircase, legs extended down several steps, leaning back on his hands with both soles facing the camera and a cat sleeping on his shins.
tasks.camera: front low view up the stairs at soles and supporting hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera fully visible; supporting hands flat with fingers
tasks.intent_zh: 阶梯撑手伸脚展示手掌足底

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a gym mat, the blue tiger performs a seated leg raise with both feet together, soles facing the camera, using a jump rope held taut in both hands.
tasks.camera: front eye-level shot of raised soles and taut rope
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles together facing camera, toes visible; five fingers on rope
tasks.intent_zh: 垫上举腿拉绳展示手掌足底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a pool lounger, feet raised and soles toward the viewer, squirting sunscreen from a bottle held in one hand onto his other palm.
tasks.camera: low angled shot of raised soles and hands with bottle
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles raised and visible; both hands with five fingers shown
tasks.intent_zh: 躺椅涂防晒展示手掌与足底

tasks.instruction: Seated on a rocking chair, the blue tiger rocks back with feet lifted, both soles presented to the camera as he knits with two needles.
tasks.camera: front three-quarter view of rocking soles and knitting hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera with toes visible; five fingers manipulating needles
tasks.intent_zh: 摇椅织毛线展示手掌足底

tasks.instruction: Lying propped on cushions, the blue tiger raises both legs and claps his soles together in a rhythm, holding a small drum in both hands.
tasks.camera: front view framing the clapping soles and drum hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles turned toward camera mid-clap, toes and pads visible; fingers on drum visible
tasks.intent_zh: 脚掌打拍击鼓展示手掌足底

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a park bench, the blue tiger stretches both legs forward, soles facing the camera, feeding crumbs to pigeons from a paper bag in his hands.
tasks.camera: front low shot of soles on the path and hands with bag
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles facing camera clearly with four toes each
tasks.intent_zh: 长椅喂鸽子伸脚展示双足底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a sofa, legs draped over the armrest with soles toward the viewer, solving a crossword with a pencil in one hand and eraser in the other.
tasks.camera: side-front angle on soles and hands with pencil
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles over armrest fully visible; fingers holding pencil and eraser shown
tasks.intent_zh: 沙发填字展示手掌与足底

tasks.instruction: Seated on a skateboard, the blue tiger rolls slowly forward with both feet lifted and soles facing the camera, one hand steering the board and one waving a flag.
tasks.camera: front tracking view of lifted soles and hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles raised toward camera with all toes visible
tasks.intent_zh: 滑板抬脚展示双足底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits on a tall tree branch, legs dangling with soles toward the camera, using both hands to peel a large orange.
tasks.camera: low front view up at dangling soles and peeling hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both dangling soles facing camera with toes; five fingers peeling visible
tasks.intent_zh: 树上剥橙展示手掌与足底

tasks.instruction: Reclining on an inflatable raft, the blue tiger lifts both feet and balances a paper umbrella on one sole tip, the other sole flat toward the camera, holding a juice box.
tasks.camera: low water-level shot of both soles and umbrella
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles visible, one balancing umbrella tip, toes clearly shown
tasks.intent_zh: 气筏上脚掌顶伞展示双足底

tasks.instruction: Sitting in a theatre seat, the blue tiger props both feet on the row ahead, soles facing back toward the camera, munching popcorn from a bucket in his lap.
tasks.camera: rear over-shoulder view of propped soles and popcorn hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles propped and facing camera with toes; fingers in popcorn visible
tasks.intent_zh: 影院翘脚吃爆米花展示手掌足底

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits in a wheelbarrow, legs up over the rim with both soles facing the camera, gripping the handles with both hands as someone pushes.
tasks.camera: front low view of soles over the rim and gripping hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles over the rim fully visible; five fingers on handles shown
tasks.intent_zh: 独轮车抬脚握把展示手掌足底
